chapters.title: Welcome to Angular! 🚀
chapters.description: Discover what Angular is, set up your coding environment, and build your very first app in minutes.

chapters.title: Components & Templates 🧩
chapters.description: Master components and templates – the core building blocks of every Angular UI.

chapters.title: Directives Deep Dive 🎯
chapters.description: Harness the power of built‑in and custom directives to transform your templates.

chapters.title: Services & Dependency Injection 💉
chapters.description: Learn how to share logic across your app using services and Angular’s powerful DI system.

chapters.title: Routing & Navigation 🧭
chapters.description: Turn your app into a multi‑page experience with Angular’s router and lazy loading.

chapters.title: Forms: Template‑Driven & Reactive 📋
chapters.description: Build dynamic, validated forms using both template‑driven and reactive approaches.

chapters.title: Pipes & Data Transformation 🎨
chapters.description: Transform display values instantly with built‑in pipes and create your own custom pipes.

chapters.title: HTTP Client & Observables 🌐
chapters.description: Communicate with servers and master RxJS Observables to handle asynchronous data.

chapters.title: Angular Modules & NgModule 📦
chapters.description: Organise your app with feature modules, shared modules, and the core module pattern.

chapters.title: State Management with RxJS 🔄
chapters.description: Go beyond services and manage complex state with Subjects and simple RxJS stores.

chapters.title: Testing Angular Apps 🧪
chapters.description: Write unit tests and component tests to keep your app rock‑solid.

chapters.title: Performance & Best Practices ⚡
chapters.description: Optimise change detection, bundle size, and learn production‑ready patterns.
